prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 75.8%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 74.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.0%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Add Interactive Tips to Waiting Screen', 'Pet Preview Screen Before Adoption Certificate', 'Pet Command Carousel on Waiting Screen', 'Pet Customization Sound & Voice Selection Screen', 'Desktop Visibility Troubleshooting Checklist', 'Compact Account Persistence Options Layout']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Defer Sign-In After Adoption', 'Photo Upload Customization Guidance', 'Grid Layout for Path Options', 'Interactive Controls Tutorial on Home Intro', 'Account Sync Warning Copy on Sign In', 'Time Estimate and Progress Counter on Choose Path', 'Pet Naming and Personality Quiz Screen', 'Desktop Ready Notification Trigger on Waiting Screen', 'Desktop Tray Shortcut Hint on Home Intro', 'Story Screen Animated Companion Showcase', 'Existing Account Pet Recovery Headline', 'Desktop Placement Troubleshooting Headline', 'Desktop Controls Quick Reference on Waiting Screen', 'Companion Behavior Audio Teaser Screen', 'Pet Playtime Animation Preview on Story Screen', 'Quick Interaction Cheat Sheet Card', 'Account Recovery and Sync Security Banner', 'Desktop Pet Quick Controls Spotlight View', 'Pet Habitat Selection Screen', 'Account Sync & Pet Safety Clarification', 'Desktop Engine Status Progress Notification', 'Desktop Tray & Dock Shortcut Setup Screen', 'Desktop Render Diagnostics & Audio Tip on Waiting', 'Desktop Visibility Quick Toggle Instructions', 'Interactive Companion Animation Simulator on Waiting Screen']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Redesign Pick Friend Screen with Stage Layout', 'Redesign Home Intro with Desktop Overlay Guide', 'Official Adoption Stamp & Progress Indicator', 'Starter Companion Bonus Highlight on Story Screen', 'First Desktop Drop Interactive Showcase', 'Cloud Backup and Multi-Device Account Screen Redesign', 'Starter Accessory Kit Gift Unlocked Banner', 'Pet Care Basics Checklist on Waiting Screen', 'Desktop Spawn Checklist Guide on Home Intro', 'Desktop Pet Interaction Controls Walkthrough', 'Redesigned Adoption Certificate Celebration View', 'Desktop Pet Mood & Energy Teaser', 'Desktop Pet Care & Interaction Guide Screen', 'Split Path Selection Hub', 'Account Sync & Pet Retention Hub', 'Photo Requirements & Generation Time Hint', 'Welcome Companion Reward Unlocked Badge', 'Companion Archetype Selection Screen', 'Multi-Provider Quick Access Sign-In Redesign', 'Pet Trait & Personality Customization Flow', 'Desktop Control Hotkeys Summary Screen', 'Exclusive Early Adopter Badge Offer', 'Photo Quality Verification Checklist Hint']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Waiting screen info enhancements (wait_info) were helpful, winning 3 tests (+5.0%, +5.7%, +4.1%), though 4 tests showed no clear effect.
Adding new screens (new_screen) can be helpful, winning 2 tests (+15.4%, +6.4%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 3 showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) can be helpful, winning 1 test (+7.0%), though 1 test showed no clear effect.
Reordering steps (reorder) hurt performance in 1 test (-3.8%) and showed no clear effect in another.
Copy changes, redesigns, hints, and notifications showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins (e.g., predicting +3.0% vs +15.4% measured, +0.0% vs +7.0% measured) and were too high for tests showing no clear effect or losses.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Pet Desk Appearance Warmup Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated transition screen right after waiting to signal that the desktop engine is launching the pet onto the screen.
candidates.why: Conversion drops significantly at the finish step (64.8%, mean time 5815s) and 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on the desktop.

new_desktop_launch.headline: Launching Pet to Desktop
new_desktop_launch.body: Preparing desktop graphics engine and companion behaviors...

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Display Verification Tip
candidates.change: Displays an explanatory tip on the waiting screen showing users how to check the system tray if their pet does not immediately appear.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported the pet not showing up on the desktop or the app stalling, while wait_info enhancements previously yielded up to +5.7% wins.

waiting.hint: If your pet does not appear on your screen after loading, check your system tray or taskbar icon.

candidates.title: Choose Path Screen Split Feature Showcase Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the choose_path screen into a clear side-by-side split layout detailing preset vs custom photo creation paths.
candidates.why: Choose path screen has high mean duration (514s), indicating hesitation; layout improvements can increase decision speed and conversion.

choose_path.headline: Choose How Your Desktop Companion Comes to Life
choose_path.body: Select standard companion adoption or create a unique pet from photo upload.

candidates.title: Pet Customization Photo Quality Preview Flow
candidates.change: Introduces an inline photo verification and live pet generation preview step on the upload_photos screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails complained about custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect, which causes drop-off in the adoption step (74.8% conversion).

candidates.title: Pick Friend Two Column Companion Comparison
candidates.change: Changes the pick_friend layout to a side-by-side two-column view to compare starter pet traits.
candidates.why: Adoption stage takes a median of 89s and mean of 1017s; layout redesigns previously improved conversion by up to +7.0%.

pick_friend.headline: Compare Companion Characters
pick_friend.body: Select your ideal companion character to start your adoption process.

candidates.title: Account Sign-In Existing Pet Data Preservation Notice
candidates.change: Updates headline and body on the sign-in screen to explicitly state that signing in saves existing pets and prevents resets.
candidates.why: Top support issue (8 emails) was pets missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Preserve Your Pet & Companion Progress
sign_in.body: Creating or signing into your account locks in your pets so they never reset or get lost.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Quick Command Overview Screen
candidates.change: Adds a post-onboarding guidance screen showing how to right-click, hide, control, and talk to the pet.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about post-onboarding confusion regarding pet controls, and finish completion rate is currently low at 64.8%.

new_quick_commands.headline: How to Control & Interact with Your Pet
new_quick_commands.body: Right-click your companion on the desktop to open settings, start talking, or send your pet to the system tray.

candidates.title: Desktop Rendering Engine Status Indicator on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Adds progress tracking indicators and time estimates for background engine rendering while users wait.
candidates.why: Home waiting stage has long wait times (median 201s, mean 2336s); clear progress status reduces drop-off during long wait times.

waiting.hint: Preparing rendering assets and spawning desktop pet...

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Ready Alert Trigger
candidates.change: Enables readiness notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when their pet is ready to appear on desktop.
candidates.why: High mean wait time on home step (2336s) indicates users switch away while waiting; notification brings them back to finish.

waiting.headline: Your Companion is Ready to Explore Your Desktop!

candidates.title: Home Intro Spotlight Onboarding Complete View
candidates.change: Switches home_intro screen to a spotlight layout focusing on immediate desktop pet interaction.
candidates.why: Finish screen step conversion is only 64.8%; spotlighting completion creates a clear transition into active usage.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Pet is Active!
home_intro.body: Your companion is now roaming your desktop screen. Click to say hello!
